body:
As I explained in [comments](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/117496#pullrequestreview-4334789152), this is intentional.

For example, if you use IK to rotate a bone that was originally facing 90 degrees to 270 degrees, and then the handle uses the IK result, the original pose will become 270 degrees the moment you grab the handle, which will corrupt the original pose that the modifier references. This means that even if you disable the modifier, the bone will not revert to its original pose; The modifiers must not affect the original pose.

Therefore, as I mentioned in the comment, if you want to display the handle while the modifier is active, you must either force the modifier to be disabled in BoneEditMode or restrict the handle display to only those bones that are not affected by the modifier.
